phase_0.boundary_condition: The closed observational light cone seals the narrowband detection event and its candidate source set within a single terminal boundary that contains the whole system.

⊢.justification: Before the narrowband detection event is named the register holds no source and no signal state, matching the initial object void before anything exists.

⊣.justification: The closed observational light cone contains the detection event and candidate source set as the terminal anchor that closes and bounds the system.

≻.justification: The directed forward morphism carries the detection irreversibly or semi-reversibly toward source attribution through structural bond formation.

≺.justification: The contravariant reverse morphism descends from the sealed record to the distributed candidate source locations along the signed directional interface.

⋈.justification: Sequential composition chains the forward bond formation and reverse candidate tracing into the composite origin attribution process.

⊙.justification: At the critical threshold the system recognizes itself where xi approaches infinity and mu composed with delta equals id, and the achiral interface is self-complementary under mirror exchange.

∈.justification: One detection state opens into accepting pole and donating pole candidate arms because origin selection follows disjunctive partner logic where any one candidate from the set suffices.

∋.justification: The carried candidate alternatives rejoin by union into a single origin state, with conflicting candidate claims holding both true and false at once.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm touches constructive truth when the gate is open and the signal origin is kinetically frozen and attributed to a candidate source.

⊥.justification: The negative arm touches constructive falsity when no candidate source is confirmed and no persistent orientational symmetry breaking establishes an origin.

⊞.justification: Both true and false are held at once when multiple candidate sources each claim the origin and the disjunctive selection remains live without resolution.

⊡.justification: The permanent append-only fixation records the narrowband detection event and candidate source set so it cannot be undone.
